title: Python modules: a star import whose literal __all__ names a submodule must reach it
description: S3 (GCLI-75) review follow-up, DEC-303 (a8): moduleExports resolves star-exported names through resolveName, so inner/__init__.py with __all__=['sub'] and inner/sub.py never reaches inner/sub.py (attribute-not-found, counted unresolvedFirstParty) although Python binds it. Carried from the Opus S3 round-3 finding 8; pre-existing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: from inner import * with a literal __all__ naming submodule sub resolves the name to inner/sub.py
a test pins it, including a two-hop chain
